description: Cloudflare Workers platform limits and runtime gotchas

entries.bad_pattern: Binding user/data-derived strings into SQL LIKE patterns (`%token%`) without capping their length
entries.good_pattern: Cap LIKE pattern bind values to <=48 bytes (50-byte D1 limit minus the two % wildcards) before binding
entries.description: Remote Cloudflare D1 enforces a 50-byte maximum LIKE/GLOB pattern length and throws "D1_ERROR: LIKE or GLOB pattern too complex: SQLITE_ERROR" beyond it. Local wrangler dev (miniflare) uses stock SQLite with a ~50KB limit, so the bug ONLY appears in production. Hit 2026-06-11: a related-research query bound a 70-byte canonical-query token (clarification metadata like "use_case:equalmix.-some-of-my-kids-art...") and one migrated page 500'd remotely while rendering fine locally with identical data.
entries.context: Any D1 query using LIKE with bound patterns derived from queries/slugs/tokens

entries.bad_pattern: Using a KV read-modify-write counter (get -> +cost -> put) as the source of truth for a budget/limit checked under concurrency
entries.good_pattern: For accuracy-critical totals (budget gates), SUM an immutable D1 column (e.g. SUM(cost_usd)) instead of a KV counter; keep KV only as a soft cache
entries.description: KV has no atomic increment/CAS. Two concurrent Worker invocations (JOB_CONCURRENCY parallel /complete calls, or chat + research) both read the same value and the second put overwrites the first, dropping a run's cost and letting spend drift past MONTHLY_BUDGET_USD. Each completion is a distinct isolate (no shared memory) so the get/put windows interleave. Fixed 2026-06-16 by deriving month spend from D1 SUM(cost_usd) (immutable per row).
entries.context: incrementMonthlyCost / any KV counter feeding a gate under concurrent writers

entries.bad_pattern: Finalizing a job row (UPDATE ... status='complete'/'failed' WHERE id=?) with no state guard, plus an unconditional cost increment / paid side-effects
entries.good_pattern: Guard terminal writes with `AND status='processing'` and gate cost increments / paid resolvers / IndexNow on meta.changes===1 so a replayed completion is a no-op
entries.description: An endpoint that finalizes a row by id alone is not idempotent: a replayed/retried completion (off-CF worker re-POST, or a /complete arriving after the cron reaper already failed the row) re-counts the budget, re-runs paid Serper resolvers, re-pings IndexNow, and can clobber a published 'complete' row to 'failed'. The CF queue consumer already used `AND status='pending'` + a meta.changes===0 skip; the off-CF /api/internal/complete path lacked it. Fixed 2026-06-16.

entries.bad_pattern: Assuming `git push origin main` deploys the truerank Worker
entries.good_pattern: Push to main — GitHub Actions runs unit tests then `wrangler deploy` (.github/workflows/deploy.yml). Manual: `export $(grep -v '^#' .cf-token | xargs) && npx wrangler deploy`
entries.description: CI added 2026-07-03: .github/workflows/deploy.yml deploys on push to main after unit tests. Requires CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN repo secret. wrangler.toml has account_id for CI. Worker runtime secrets (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, etc.) remain in Cloudflare only.

entries.bad_pattern: Designing a single Worker invocation to make 100s of searches + page reads (deep agent loop) on Cloudflare
entries.good_pattern: Keep per-invocation work under ~950 subrequests and ~20 min; offload deep/long research to the off-CF blackbox worker (Approach B: it polls /api/internal/next-job, runs the engine, POSTs results to /complete)
entries.description: CF Workers cap each invocation at 1000 subrequests (engine reserves at 950) and the cron reaper fails rows stuck 'processing' >20 min. Deep research (100s of tool calls) doesn't fit; the off-Cloudflare worker removes the ceiling. See memory truerank-deploy-and-engine.
entries.context: engine depth / agent-loop budget on CF
